card.summary: The December 2025 refresh of Qwen-Image (Q8_0 on 24 GB). Same 20B architecture and best-in-class legible text rendering (EN/ZH), with improved realism/aesthetics and prompt adherence over the original. Higher-precision Q8_0 quant for maximum fidelity.
card.pick_when: You want the latest Qwen-Image at maximum quality for accurate in-image text or top-tier prompt adherence, and have a 24 GB card.

prompt.guidance: Detailed natural-language prose (EN or ZH). Quote literal text to render it.
prompt.example: A bookstore storefront at dusk, a glowing sign reading "NIGHT OWL BOOKS" in warm amber letters, rain-slicked pavement reflecting the glow, cinematic
prompt.instructions: Write descriptive natural language; word order and specificity matter. To render literal text, wrap the exact string in double quotes and keep it short. Recommended: ~20-50 steps, cfg ~4, euler/simple. Native resolution ~1328px. Negative prompts are supported (real CFG).
do: Use a light negative if needed
dont: Expect long paragraphs of in-image text to stay perfect

speed.measured_note: 20B Q8_0 on 24 GB; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in plain words. Best here for pictures that need readable text or signs.
